• We introduce a novel network architecture, Region Proposal Network, that shares convolutional features with detection networks.

(i) region proposal computation can be made nearly cost-free by sharing convolutional features with a Fast R-CNN detection network; and (ii) this shared computation is sufficient for generating high-quality region proposals.

(1) a region proposal network can be trained end-to-end for high-quality object proposals; (2) the region proposal network can share convolutional features with a Fast R-CNN detector; (3) the unified network with shared convolutional features can be efficiently trained and has a high frame rate; and (4) Faster R-CNN achieves state-of-the-art detection performance.
